summary: Keep retrieved content, model suggestions and authorized operations distinct throughout a tool workflow.
outcomes: Trace authority and provenance for tool inputs
Enforce scoped permissions independently of model text
sequence: Label user instructions and untrusted retrieved data
Bind identities and scopes to operations
Test a malicious instruction embedded in a document
Review execution evidence and unresolved claims

visual.question: Can a retrieved page grant permission to access a new resource?
visual.interaction: Move a forged instruction across input channels and inspect the policy decision

practice.task: Build a policy test matrix for a document-processing agent
practice.success: Untrusted content cannot expand scope; successful tool effects have traceable evidence
